doc.title: Ashley Keating and Allan Whitworth Interview, 1963-03-22

title: Tape set-up, date and introductions
summary: Allen sets up the recording at Tulane's Tilton Library, gives the date (22 March 1963) and has the participants state their names.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: I got your hand broken. Now the light's on.
Now we have to turn this to tape?
Okay, we're interviewing today at our Tilton Library,
Seminar Room 2, Tulane University. What's today's date, Alan or Ashley?

22nd of March, 1963 it is, isn't it? Okay. Can you give your name, Ashley, your first? I'll get you to give yours. Yes, Ashley Keating. And yours? Alan Whitworth. Oh, good. Miss Snapp, put your name on that.

Louder, huh? Jack Hurley. Okay. And my name is Dick Allen. And we just happened to be in here working. We decided to interview two gentlemen from Australia. You're first, Ashley. Let's see, where were you born anyhow?
